enroll.title: Follow this plan
enroll.hint: Day 1 of the PDF will match the start date you choose. Optionally, you can mark readings already done by date (aligned with the calendar and the plan’s day sequence).
enroll.catchUpFieldHint: Marks from day 1 through the plan day that matches this date, in a continuous rhythm.
enroll.advancedIntro: Use when you want to mark a range of calendar days as read (helpful if you didn’t start on day 1 or read in jumps). Only fill this if you know the exact range.

errors.advancedPartial: Fill both start and end of the extra range, or leave both empty.

upload.title: Import PDF plan
upload.hint: Upload a PDF with selectable text. Image-only PDFs cannot be imported.

planPassage.title: Plan reading
planPassage.subtitle: Day {{day}} · {{book}} {{from}}–{{to}}
planPassage.alreadyDone: This day’s reading is already logged on your plan. Well done!
planPassage.confirmBody: You reached the last chapter of this reading. If you’ve already read today’s passage, confirm to update your progress, streak, and calendar.
planPassage.noReferenceDate: Could not get the plan reference date. Try closing and opening again.

errors.noReference: Reference date unavailable. Close and open again from the start.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.hint: Enter your current password and a new password (minimum 8 characters).
